claire-cs: Quick help needed from infra/eng. Customer onboarding embed job spikes 401 then a cascade of 429s right after we roll. Happens only during the ramp job (prewarm workers). Anyone seen serverless warmup trigger auth -> rlimit?

miguel-eng: Yep. Two common causes: (1) every function instance fetches a short-lived token at cold start -> simultaneous valid/invalid tokens, (2) proxy or edge cache rewriting auth headers so some requests hit unauthorized. Can you paste the init and the warmup pattern?

claire-cs: Warmup job does 100 parallel invocations, each runs: ```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY, keepAlive: true, batchSize: 400 });
await client.embeddings.create({input: docs.slice(0, 50)});
```
Logs: first wave show "401 unauthorized - token" then many "429 embed_units".

rani-support: If the token TTL is short and your token service gives slightly different times or clock skew, you can see immediate 401s followed by retries that push you into 429. Also, if your proxy uses a connection pool and closes sockets unpredictably you might see duplicate preflight attempts.

miguel-eng: Short checklist: reduce parallelism during warmup (try ≤8 concurrent), lower batchSize to 64-128, add random splay to token refresh, and implement a process-local token cache with a refresh lock. Also consider disabling keepAlive for cold-start-heavy jobs to avoid pooled-socket fanout.

claire-cs: We use an internal edge proxy with auth_request to our identity service and forward Authorization. No caching. Token rotation is every 45s.

miguel-eng: 45s is tight for large fanouts. Without splay, all instances will fetch near the same cadence. Add jitter on issuance or client-side fetch: +Math.floor(Math.random()*30). Example token cache: ```js
let T=null; let exp=0; let lock=false; async function getToken(){const now=Date.now()/1000; if(T && now < exp-10) return T; if(lock){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50+Math.random()*200)); return T;} lock=true; try{ const res = await fetch('/internal-token'); T=await res.text(); exp=now+50+Math.random()*20; return T;} finally{lock=false;} }
```

rani-support: Temporary lift: we can increase your embed-unit window for 1hr while you run a soak. Also we can whitelist your warmup IPs so small auth failures don't immediately consume quota. Want us to do that?

claire-cs: Yes please for the 1hr window. We'll reduce warmup concurrency to 6, batchSize -> 128, add the splay on token fetch, and disable keepAlive for the warmup process.

miguel-eng: Also add exponential backoff with jitter on retries (base 100ms, factor 2, max 5 attempts). That prevents retry storms turning 401s into 429s.

infra-bot: Action created: CS-8342 (temporary embed-unit window uplift) assigned to rani-support.

claire-cs: After the changes we saw 401s drop to near-zero and the 429 spikes smoothed during the 30min soak. Will report after 3h soak. Thanks! :raised_hands:
